# netbox_contact (Data Source)

Retrieves a single contact from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_contact" "example" {
  name = "Jane Doe"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the contact.
- `name` (String) The name of the contact. At least one of `name` or `slug` must be given.
- `slug` (String) The URL-friendly slug of the contact. At least one of `name` or `slug` must be given.

### Read-Only

- `group_id` (Number, Deprecated) The ID of the group associated with the contact.
- `group_ids` (List of Number) The IDs of the group associated with the contact.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
